item.text:
`npm run weather` failed because [src/weather.js](/private/tmp/envtest.FW4WnB/shop-api/src/weather.js) called `api.weather.invalid`, which cannot resolve. I changed it to fetch current conditions for Tallinn from Open-Meteo and report HTTP or missing-data errors.

Verified: `npm run weather` now exits successfully and prints current weather data. This repo contains no widget UI, so I could verify the weather command but not the widget display.
